ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Depths of Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of child care fraud in Minnesota and beyond, following the money trail to uncover the individuals and organizations involved.
questions: How widespread is child care fraud in Minnesota?
What organizations are involved in the scam?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a large-scale scam, and that following the money trail will lead to some surprising revelations.
